projects.title: Cappy — Hinglish AI Caption Studio
projects.short_description: A browser-based AI caption editor for ten Indian languages, merging two speech-recognition engines into per-word captions and rendering video entirely client-side.
projects.description:
Cappy is a caption studio that runs in the browser. It merges dual ASR engines — Sarvam for text and Gladia for timings — using Needleman–Wunsch sequence alignment, then applies Devanagari–Latin transliteration to produce accurate per-word captions across 10 Indian languages.

The render pipeline carries no server cost: Remotion drives the preview, captions are burned in on canvas, and ffmpeg.wasm transcodes the final MP4 in the browser rather than on a backend.

On top of that sits a CapCut-style timeline editor with 32 templates. It is deployed on Vercel, with serverless functions used only as thin proxies to keep API keys off the client.

projects.title: HookGuard — Webhook Signature Gateway
projects.short_description: A zero-dependency Go gateway that verifies inbound webhook signatures for four providers behind a single pluggable interface, forwarding only authenticated traffic.
projects.description:
HookGuard sits in front of an application and refuses any webhook it cannot cryptographically verify. Stripe, Shopify, GitHub and PayPal are each handled behind one pluggable Verifier interface, so adding a provider does not touch the gateway itself.

Verification is constant-time HMAC-SHA256 computed over the raw request body, which is what prevents both signature bypass and timing attacks. PayPal additionally requires RSA-SHA256 against a fetched certificate, so that path carries an SSRF guard on the fetch.

It is written in Go with no third-party dependencies, covered by table-driven unit tests per provider, and ships via Docker Compose.

projects.title: High-Throughput Flash Sale Engine
projects.short_description: An event-driven Spring Boot backend sustaining 10,000+ transactions per second under 5ms latency, with Redis atomic locking guaranteeing zero overselling.
projects.description:
A flash sale is a worst-case concurrency problem: thousands of buyers contend for a small, fixed stock in the same second. This engine handles 10,000+ TPS at under 5ms latency, using Redis atomic locking to keep stock counts perfectly consistent and make overselling impossible.

Writes are decoupled through Apache Kafka so PostgreSQL never absorbs the traffic spike directly, and endpoints are protected with Bucket4j rate limiting.

The stack is instrumented with Prometheus and Grafana and containerised end to end with Docker Compose.

projects.title: PhishX - Phishing Detection Web App
projects.short_description: A multilingual SMS phishing detection system combining BERT and Naive Bayes models with explainable AI features for transparency.
projects.description:
PhishX is a specialized security tool designed to detect phishing in multilingual SMS (English and Hinglish) using a hybrid approach of BERT, XLM-R language detection, and TF-IDF Naive Bayes models.
The project features a full Streamlit web interface that provides real-time spam probability scoring and a custom confidence meter. 
A key differentiator is its focus on model interpretability; it includes explainability features like TF-IDF feature importance and BERT attention visualization to help users understand the reasoning behind borderline phishing classifications.

projects.title: Reddit Sentiment Analysis Web App
projects.short_description: A real-time sentiment analysis dashboard that classifies Reddit and news data using RoBERTa models with high accuracy.
projects.description:
This web application performs real-time sentiment analysis by integrating with Reddit and News APIs to fetch live data based on user-defined subreddits and queries. 
It employs a RoBERTa-based model to classify posts with 68% accuracy, validated against standard classification metrics.
The application features a responsive UI that visualizes sentiment trends through WordClouds, bar charts, and pie charts, while also offering CSV export functionality for further data analysis.

projects.title: KisanGPT
projects.short_description: A real-time AI agricultural advisory system utilizing RAG pipelines and Gemini LLM to provide multilingual farming support.
projects.description:
This project is an advanced agricultural advisory tool designed to assist farmers by answering queries in both Hindi and English. 
It utilizes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline powered by Qdrant vector search to retrieve relevant context from domain-specific PDFs and a dataset of over 3.5 lakh KCC queries. 
The system integrates dynamic context fusion with the Gemini LLM to deliver accurate, context-aware recommendations for crops, fertilizers, and disease treatments.
It features an interactive Streamlit user interface that exposes retrieved sources and provides concise, actionable insights optimized for non-technical users.
